content: service method TransferData [SWS_UCM_00346] Upstream: RS_UCM_00019 , RS_UCM_00025 TransferData (IN TransferIdType id, IN ByteVectorType Management data, IN uint64_t blockCounter) Block-wise transfer of a Software Package to UCM. Scope service interface PackageManagement class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td id td IN td TransferIdType td Transfer ID. td data td IN td ByteVectorType Management td Data block of the Software Package. td blockCounter td IN td uint64_t td Block counter value of the current block. Application Errors th Fehler th Beschreibung td kOperationNotPermitted td The operation is not supported in the current context. td kTransferIdInvalid td The Transfer ID is invalid. td kBlockIncorrect td The same block number is received twice. td kBlockSizeIncorrect td The size of the block exceeds the provided block size from TransferStart or Transfer VehiclePackage. td kSizeIncorrect td The size of the Software or Vehicle Package exceeds the provided size in TransferStart. td kMemoryInsufficient td Insufficient memory to perform operation. td kTransferFailed td UCM cannot persist transferred block. td kBlockInconsistent td Consistency check for transferred block failed. td kPackageFormatUnsupported td The Vehicle Package or Software Package archiving format is not supported. td kAuthenticationFailed td Package authentication failed. td kPackageManifestInvalid td Package manifest could not be read. td kPackageVersionIncompatible td The version of the Software or Vehicle Package to be processed is not compatible with the current version of UCM or V-UCM. td kPackageInconsistent td Package integrity check failed. td kSwclRemovalDenied td Attempt to remove PLATFORM_CORE Software Cluster. td kOldVersion td Software Package version is too old.
